notes.title: The Cooking Club Demo – Coming October 2nd! 🍳✨
notes.notes:
[h2]Originally, we aimed for a [b]6th October 2025[/b] release, but due to Steam’s requirement that demos are available by the [b]3rd[/b], we’ve decided to move things forward.[/h2][p][/p][h3]🗓 [b]New Release Date:[/b] 2nd October 2025
🕛 [b]Time:[/b] Midnight (BST)[/h3][p][/p][p][b]What’s included in the demo?[/b][/p][list][*][p]A [b]short prologue[/b] introducing the world of [i]The Cooking Club[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Meet the girls for the very first time[/p][/*][*][p]A setup that leads directly into Chapter One[/p][/*][/list][p]For those curious, the demo contains:[/p][list][*][p][b]591 dialogue blocks[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Roughly [b]6,641 words[/b][/p][/*][*][p]About [b]36,550 characters[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait for you to get your first taste of [i]The Cooking Club[/i] and share your thoughts with us. 💕[/p]

notes.title: Check Out The Cooking Club's New Redesign!
notes.notes:

Studio Maroo.. and even twitch streamer and affiliate Clunia join us![/p][p][/p][p]So here we are.. and we don't want to waste anymore time.. so without further ado.. check out the trailer below alongside some new cover art (which you saw on this blog post) AND an updated "look" at the girls' via their "info cards" which can be found on our [b]Steam Page[/b].
